objective: Define the minimal refusal boundary for filelist-derived templates with known incomplete source closure before non-dry-run execution.

refusal_boundary.refusal_point: run_hybrid_template.py before the first non-dry-run subprocess and before Verilator
refusal_boundary.unknown_status_behavior: risk_metadata_only; not treated as complete evidence; not refused by this compatibility-preserving gate

required_result_gate.name: filelist_source_closure_non_dry_run_refusal_result_gate
must_validate: dry-run remains allowed for the same incomplete template as plan-only evidence
error text includes source_closure.status and missing required sources
existing complete filelist template remains loadable
unknown or missing source_closure is not promoted to complete evidence

non_claims: not automatic dependency inference for arbitrary RTL
not proof that unknown source closure is complete
